spanish: Tres cálices almendrados en la caña la una, manzana y flor, y tres cálices almendrados en la caña la una, manzana y flor; así a las seis cañas las salientes desde la menorá.

findings.issue: H3730 is a knob or capital; manzana names the fruit apple, a concept the noun does not license.
H4501 is the common noun lampstand; menorá leaves that non-name lemma untranslated.

notes: The repeated cup clause, pual almond participle, and qal going-out from the lampstand stay within the tokens.
